notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 object-instance name reservation and release services in Umbra's non-installable embedded development profile. It validates the official HLA. namespace and empty-set guards, asynchronous single and multiple reservation outcomes, atomic multiple release, resignation cleanup, and the focused filesystem successful-void reports for the single-name and StringSet multiple-name requests. Named registration consumes reservations in a later slice; save/restore, remote transport, package support, protected review, and conformance remain outside this contract.
